t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Ekau tui maoki loku Atua, na ke faka tupu au ke kau iloa ma atolasio ki lou agai. Ekau tui maoki ile temi nei, iloku gaegae ki lou puleaga, loku mativa ki lou kalasia. Tie kau tui fuai kile Atua etasi, kole pule taualuga mo mafimafi. Eina saofaki tatou mei le fakasala, mo tuutamaki kesekese ole malama.
